scripts.text: This kind of thicket grows everywhere in Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation: 這種灌木叢在幻影魔境隨處可見。

scripts.text: This thicket looks like it's hiding some herbs. What do you want to do?
scripts.translation: 這叢灌木看起來藏著一些草藥。你想怎麼做？

scripts.text: Gather the herb.
scripts.translation: 收集草藥

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: You've decided to forget about it.
scripts.translation: 你決定放棄。

scripts.text: No herbs were found in the thicket.
scripts.translation: 灌木叢裡沒有發現草藥。

scripts.text: Gathered the herb.
scripts.translation: 已收集草藥。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Don't worry about him.
He knows what he's doing.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
別擔心他。
他知道自己在做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
...?
Interesting.
He wants something ready to eat, juicy, refreshing, and clean-tasting?
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
...？
有意思。
他想要現成的、多汁、清爽且口感乾淨的食物？

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Did you forget the ingredients?
2 Meats, 1 Mora Mandarin, and 1 Banana.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
你忘了食材嗎？
2份肉類，1個穆拉柑橘，和1根香蕉。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
This should suffice.
I haven't cooked it in a while, but the recipe is in my head.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
這些應該夠了。
我有一陣子沒做飯了，但食譜我記得很清楚。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
*Chuckle*
If you need more, it'll be easier to buy it from the Mora Village.
Do whatever it takes to win favor with that old man.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
*輕笑*
如果你還需要更多，去穆拉村買會更方便。
無論如何，都要讓那位老人滿意。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
This place is boring, just like everywhere else.
Aren't there stronger monsters?
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
這地方真無聊，和其他地方一樣。
難道沒有更強的魔物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Well, I've got an idea. Bring me some ingredients, and I'll cook something for you.
I'm pretty sure it'll fit the bill.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
好吧，我有個主意。給我一些食材，我為你做點吃的。
我相信那應該符合要求。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
The problem is
the ingredients are difficult to find.
I've learned this recipe while traveling across dimensions.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
問題是
食材很難找。
我在學習這個食譜時，曾穿越過各個次元。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Well, it'll be you who has to find the ingredients:
2 Meats, 1 Mora Mandarin, and 1 Banana. Can you get them?
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
好吧，得由你來找食材了：
2份肉類，1個穆拉柑橘，和1根香蕉。你能找到嗎？

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Some of the fruits grow near the ^4d4dffMisty Forest Labyrinth^000000.
You'll have to look hard for them.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
有些水果生長在^4d4dff迷霧森林迷宮^000000附近。
你得仔細找找。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Some of the fruits grow near the ^4d4dffMisty Forest Labyrinth^000000.
...
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
有些水果生長在^4d4dff迷霧森林迷宮^000000附近。
...

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Done.
This food should fit all the conditions you told me.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
好了。
這道菜應該符合你告訴我的所有條件。

scripts.text:
Luke gave you Mora's specialty food, Beef Toast.
It perfectly fits everything Ian said he wanted.
scripts.translation:
盧克給了你穆拉的特色料理，牛肉吐司。
它完美符合伊恩所說的所有要求。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Or you won't find the answer the Captain wanted.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
否則你就找不到船長想要的答案了。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Don't say that.
You'll jinx us.
I'm a brave Cat, but my claws can't even scratch those.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
別這麼說。
你會給我們帶來厄運的。
我是一隻勇敢的貓，但我的爪子連那些都抓不傷。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Alright, alright.
But don't worry.
I'm not stupid.
I'll never put my charges in danger.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
好了，好了。
但別擔心。
我不傻。
我絕不會讓我的委託人陷入危險。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You're
looking down your nose at me because I'm a Cat.
Tsk, tsk.
You Humans are so superficial.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你瞧不起我，因為我是隻貓。
嘖，嘖。
你們人類真膚淺。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You're looking down your nose at me because I'm a Cat.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你瞧不起我，因為我是隻貓。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
This place is littered with broken robots and machines.
Clouds of physical energy are discovered near them.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
這地方到處都是破碎的機器人和機器。
在它們附近可以發現物理能量雲。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Oh, this is enough.
You're good.
My estimation of you went up a notch.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
哦，這就夠了。
你很棒。
我對你的評價又高了一分。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Soon I'll need your service on a daily basis.
Don't fret and take one for the team.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
很快我就需要每天讓你為我服務了。
別擔心，就當是為團隊出一份力吧。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You know the drill: collect condensed energy.
You'll do that for me, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你知道該怎麼做：收集濃縮能量。
你會為我做的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
All you have to do is collect energy that naturally gathers around the remnants of robots and machines.
I need 10 bottles every day.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你只需要收集自然聚集在機器人和機器殘骸周圍的能量。
我每天需要10瓶。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I think I like you!
Not as much as Aures and Luke, though.
All right, I'll make good use of this energy.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
我覺得我挺喜歡你的！
雖然比不上奧雷斯和盧克。
好吧，我會好好利用這些能量的。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'm analyzing the collected energy.
...
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
我正在分析收集到的能量。
...

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Hm, maybe I need to find a special storage method.
The energy dissipates so easily.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
嗯，也許我需要找到一種特殊的儲存方法。
這種能量消散得太快了。

scripts.text: [Lloyd]
scripts.translation: [勞埃德]

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just keep your distance and mind your own business.
You and I will be fine so long as you don't steal my hard work.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
保持距離，管好你自己的事。
只要你別偷走我辛苦的成果，我們就能相安無事。

scripts.text: Are you Lloyd?
scripts.translation: 你是勞埃德嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Yeah. What's up?
Huh? Aures sent you?
To check up on my progress?
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
是啊。怎麼了？
啊？是奧雷斯派你來的？
來檢查我的研究進度？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Oh, I'm in trouble.
I must live up to his expectations,
but my research has been stagnant.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
哦，這下麻煩了。
我必須不辜負他的期望，
但我的研究一直停滯不前。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Hey, could you help
me with something?
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
嘿，你能幫
我個忙嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text: What is a Cat doing here?
scripts.translation: 一隻貓在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Unlike many from Malangdo Island, I've always been interested in new technologies and cultures.
I worked at companies, and I've learned alchemy.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
與綿綿島的許多人不同，我一直對新科技和文化很感興趣。
我在公司工作過，也學過融合試驗。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I came to Verus City when I heard the news of its discovery. I was told that I must be in an excavation team to be in the city.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
當我聽說這裡被發現的新聞時，我就來到了維魯斯城。聽說必須加入挖掘隊才能進入城中。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Aures helped me to get in.
I'm also a member of the Atnad Excavation Team.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
是奧雷斯幫我進來的。
我也是阿特納德挖掘隊的一員。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Sorry to interrupt,
but you're from the Eden Group to help the excavation team.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
抱歉打斷一下，
你是樂園團派來協助挖掘隊的。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Your job is to help Lloyd.
You can't say no.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
你的任務是協助勞埃德。
你不能拒絕。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
He's right!
You're obligated to help me with my research!
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
他說得對！
你有義務協助我的研究！

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Let's cut to the chase.
Hey, Human help.
Get 10 empty glass bottles,
and collect condensed energy found around the remnants of robots.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
我們直入正題吧。
嘿，人類幫手。
去弄10個空瓶，
然後收集機器人殘骸周圍發現的濃縮能量。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
This place is littered with broken robots and machines.
Clouds of physical energy are discovered near them.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
這地方到處都是破碎的機器人和機器。
在它們附近可以發現物理能量雲。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just bring empty bottles close to the energy, and it'll enter the bottles.
Bring me 10 bottles.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
只需將空瓶靠近能量，它就會進入瓶中。
給我帶10瓶來。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
我會等著的。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just bring empty bottles close to the energy, and it'll enter the bottles.
Bring me 10 bottles.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
只需將空瓶靠近能量，它就會進入瓶中。
給我帶10瓶來。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You must be dumber than you look if you have to ask twice.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
如果你需要問兩遍，那你肯定比看起來更笨。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You've made my job easier.
Finally, I can be useful to Aures.
If I find the cause of the condensation of energy and its possible applications, maybe
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你讓我的工作變得輕鬆多了。
終於，我能為奧雷斯派上用場了。
如果我找到能量凝結的原因及其可能的應用，也許

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Ian and I can reactivate the robots in this place.
That's what we've wanted all along.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
我和伊恩可以重新啟用這裡的機器人。
這正是我們一直想要的。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Tell Aures I'm making progress.
Good job, Human.
I'll look forward to using your service again.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
告訴奧雷斯，我正在取得進展。
幹得好，人類。
期待再次使用你的服務。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Why, do you have something else to do?
All right then,
I'll ask Luke to take me around.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
怎麼，你還有別的事要做？
那好吧，
我會請盧克帶我四處看看。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
I thought you'd never ask!
I've been itching for some action.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
我還以為你永遠不會開口呢！
我早就想大幹一場了。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
All you have to do is collect energy that naturally gathers around the remnants of robots and machines.
I need 10 bottles every day.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你只需要收集自然聚集在機器人和機器殘骸周圍的能量。
我每天需要10瓶。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Come back tomorrow.
Well, you might as well come back every day at this time.
You can't say no.
I need you.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
明天再來。
嗯，既然這樣，你最好每天都這個時間來。
你不能拒絕。
我需要你。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Are you dense?
That means I want to be left alone!
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你是笨蛋嗎？
我的意思是我想一個人待著！

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'll need more bottles of the energy.
How are you?
Are you ready to take one for the team?
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
我還需要更多瓶裝的<死亡騎士>能量。
你還好嗎？
準備好為團隊犧牲一下了嗎？

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: You don't have to collect more energy at this moment.
scripts.translation: 目前不需要收集更多能量。

scripts.text: You have enough ^4d4dffCondensed Energy^000000.
scripts.translation: 您擁有足夠的^4d4dff濃縮能量^000000。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffEmpty Bottle^000000 is required to collect Condensed Energy.
scripts.translation: 收集濃縮能量需要^4d4dff空瓶^000000。

scripts.text:
A thick cloud of energy is visible between the broken pieces of metal.
Bring an empty bottle close to the waving edges of the cloud to collect the energy.
scripts.translation:
在破碎的金屬之間可以看到一團濃厚的能量。
將空瓶靠近能量雲波動的邊緣即可收集能量。

scripts.text: Collected Condensed Energy!
scripts.translation: 已收集濃縮能量！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you heading for Phantasmagorika?
It may be difficult to find. Let me give you some directions.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
你要去幻影迷宮嗎？
那裡可能很難找。讓我給你指指路。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Follow the road all the way up, and then head southwest.
Let me mark the location on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
沿著路一直往上走，然後向西南方向前進。
讓我在你的小地圖上標記一下位置。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This place is fraught with formidable monsters, just like the other parts of the old Juperos.
Be safe in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
這個地方到處都是強大的魔物，就像舊朱佩羅斯的其他地方一樣。
祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you heading for Phantasmagorika?
It may be difficult to find. Let me give you some directions.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
你要去幻影迷宮嗎？
那裡可能很難找。讓我給你指指路。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Go straight east, then follow the road south. You'll see a giant status at a corner.
Let me mark the location on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
一直向東走，然後沿著路向南走。你會在拐角處看到一座巨大的雕像。
讓我在你的小地圖上標記一下位置。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Who knew there's a hidden place behind a statue? It was pure luck that we found it.
The road to the place is dangerous. Please have safe travel.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
誰能想到雕像後面還藏著一個地方？我們找到它純屬運氣。
去那裡的路很危險。請小心旅途。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you a participant of the Phantasmagorika project?
This is the entrance to the newly discovered ruins in the east.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
你是幻影迷宮專案的參與者嗎？
這是新發現的東部遺蹟的入口。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
There's a guide on the other side of the entrance to guide you to the excavation site.
Please get in before some monsters pounce on you.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
入口的另一邊有一位嚮導，會帶你去挖掘現場。
請快點進去，免得被魔物襲擊。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Oh, the other side of the entrance is teeming with aggressive robots.
You'd better brace yourself.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
哦，入口的另一邊全是好鬥的機器人。
你最好做好心理準備。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
Are you a participant of the Phantasmagorika project?
As you know, you're at the entrance to Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘嚮導]
你是幻影迷宮專案的參與者嗎？
如你所知，你現在位於朱佩羅斯的入口。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
I'm here to guide you to the excavation site connected to the inside of Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘嚮導]
我負責引導你前往與朱佩羅斯內部相連的挖掘現場。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
There are more guides spread across the inside,
so you can find them easily in case you get lost.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘嚮導]
內部各處都分佈著其他嚮導，
如果你迷路了，很容易就能找到他們。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
Thank you for your contribution to the development of mankind. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘嚮導]
感謝你對人類發展的貢獻。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you a member of the Excavation Group?
Our chairman has personally ordered us to see to your safety so that you can focus on your excavation work.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
你是挖掘小組的成員嗎？
會長親自下令，要求我們確保你的安全，以便你專心進行挖掘工作。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
We're here to support your excavation of Verus City.
Let us know if you experience any problems.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
我們在此支援你對維魯斯城的挖掘工作。
如果遇到問題，請隨時告知我們。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
I hate using portable johns, but my bladder can't seem to hold very much. What about you?
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
我討厭用移動廁所，但我的膀胱似乎存不住多少水。你呢？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Ack! Shoo! Don't come close! I'm saving myself for my future bride!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
啊！走開！別靠近我！我要把精力留給未來的新娘！

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
Hm, the building was crushed by the stone wall.
The rest is almost pulverized to dust.
scripts.translation:
[地質學家]
嗯，這座建築被石牆壓垮了。
其餘部分幾乎被碾成了粉末。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
The terrain on which the village stands was formed in a different period, compared to this stone wall. At least that's my initial assessment.
scripts.translation:
[地質學家]
村莊所在的地形形成於不同的時期，與這堵石牆不同。至少這是我的初步評估。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
The underground village doesn't seem to be artificial, though I can't imagine how it can be formed naturally. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[地質學家]
這個地下村莊似乎不是人工建造的，但我無法想像它是如何自然形成的。你怎麼看？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
...Are you even listening to me?
scripts.translation:
[地質學家]
...你甚至沒有在聽我說話嗎？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
Sigh.
Let's go have lunch.
scripts.translation:
[地質學家]
嘆氣。
我們去吃午飯吧。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
好的，教授！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Schwarzwald may be the most scientifically advanced among the three states of Midgard, but it still doesn't hold a candle to this place.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
修瓦魯茲巴魯德可能是米德加爾特三個國家中科學最先進的，但在這裡面前仍相形見絀。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
The same goes for Juperos. If the scientific knowledge of this place passed down to Schwarzwald, it could have been much more powerful.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
朱佩羅斯也是如此。如果這個地方的科學知識能傳承給修瓦魯茲巴魯德，它本可以更加強大。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Of course, that's based on my theory that the residents of this place were also Schwarzwaldians.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
當然，這是基於我的理論，即這裡的居民也是修瓦魯茲巴魯德人。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
I feel like I'm going insane, stuck in this confined space.
Hey, how about I read your fortune for the day with my juggling balls?
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
被困在這個狹小的空間裡，我感覺自己快要瘋了。
嘿，要不要我用雜耍球為你算算今天的運勢？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Good, choose a color you like.
The color you choose will tell me your fortune.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
很好，選一個你喜歡的顏色。
你選擇的顏色會告訴我你的運勢。

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 紅色

scripts.text: Blue
scripts.translation: 藍色

scripts.text: Yellow
scripts.translation: 黃色

scripts.text: Green
scripts.translation: 綠色

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Dum, dum, dum! Your fortune for the day!
Let's me get the fortune paper inside the ball...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
咚，咚，咚！來看看你今天的運勢吧！
讓我看看水晶球裡的運勢紙條...

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Today is...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
今天是...

scripts.text: [Pierrot]
scripts.translation: [皮埃羅]

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
The same boring day, like yesterday and the day before.
Only positive thinking will get you out of this funk. Smile and be nice to others, and maybe Lady Luck will brighten your day.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
和昨天、前天一樣，又是無聊的一天。
只有積極的心態才能讓你擺脫這種低迷。保持微笑，善待他人，也許幸運女神會照亮你的一天。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Ack, you shouldn't have gotten out of bed. Wherever you go, trouble follows.
I strongly recommend you stay at the Shelter for the day. Sleep off bad luck.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
哎呀，你就不該起床。無論你去哪裡，麻煩都會跟著你。
我強烈建議你今天待在避難所裡。睡一覺，把壞運氣都甩掉。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Not a bad day, but you'll have to work to enjoy some good luck.
Go to the Excavation Site and dig up some dirt. You may find some treasure.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
今天還不錯，但你需要付出努力才能獲得好運。
去挖掘點吧，挖點土。也許你能找到一些寶藏。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
The luckiest day of your life! Wherever you go, you'll find wealth and friends.
Maybe you'll find some historic artifacts buried in this place. That'll be awesome, huh?
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
你一生中最幸運的一天！無論你去哪裡，都會發現財富和朋友。
也許你會在這個地方發現一些埋藏的歷史文物。那一定很酷，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Do you like my reading? Or do you hate it?
Your future is pliable--you can shape it however you want.
Don't get too excited or depressed. Just stay focused on your goal.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
你喜歡我的占卜嗎？還是討厭它？
你的未來是可塑的——你可以隨心所欲地塑造它。
不要過於興奮或沮喪。只要專注於你的目標。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
All right, come back if you want another reading.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
好的，如果你想再占卜一次，隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been an important figure in Verus City.
Piles of official documents are discovered in this room.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
這棟房子的主人一定是維魯斯城的重要人物。
在這個房間裡發現了成堆的官方檔案。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
Most of the documents contain petty civil complaints, like water problems and neighbor disputes.
All the documents, however, contain the initials, OX. I don't know if they're of a name or an abbreviation of some sort.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
大多數檔案都是瑣碎的民事投訴，比如供水問題和鄰里糾紛。
然而，所有檔案上都印有“OX”的首字母。我不知道這是一個名字，還是某種縮寫。

scripts.text: - The building entrance shows distinctive wear and tear, indicating abuse by a steady stream of traffic. YHT and DO NOT YELL are written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 建築入口處顯示出明顯的磨損痕跡，表明有持續的人流經過。門上寫著“YHT”和“DO NOT YELL”。-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This building is fully furnished, yet there is no sign of habitation.
Maybe the owner lived somewhere else, like in a summer house or something.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
這棟房子設施齊全，卻沒有居住過的跡象。
也許主人住在別處，比如夏屋之類的地方。

scripts.text: - ZERT... is written on the door. The rest of the writing looks like it was scratched off with a stone.-
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“ZERT...”。剩下的字跡看起來像是被石頭刮掉的。-

scripts.text: - +1 is written on the door. What could it mean? -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“+1”。這可能意味著什麼？-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been a dancer. Her wardrobe is full of glittery stage clothes.
Judging by their size, she must have been very tall for a woman. I wonder how she looked like.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
這棟房子的主人一定是一位舞娘。她的衣櫥裡塞滿了閃閃發光的舞臺服裝。
從尺寸來看，她對於女性來說一定很高。我想知道她長什麼樣子。

scripts.text: - KDY is written on the door. Sooty streaks that spread outward from the inside to the entrance indicate frequent explosions. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KDY”。從室內向入口延伸的煙燻痕跡表明這裡經常發生爆炸。-

scripts.text: - KJH is written on the door. The entrance wall is dotted with tiny squares of paper containing time and numbers. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KJH”。入口處的牆壁上點綴著許多寫有時間與數字的小紙片。-

scripts.text: - PKY is written on the door. Empty liquor bottles are littered around the house. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“PKY”。屋子裡散落著許多空酒瓶。-

scripts.text: - DGDG'S BOARD is written on the door. What does that mean? -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“DGDG'S BOARD”。這是什麼意思？-

scripts.text: - THE SUNS is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“THE SUNS”。-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
*Cough Cough* The owner of this house was a hoarder.
Lots of books. Lots of cat furballs. Lots of Assassin pictures. *Cough Cough*
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
*咳咳* 這棟房子的主人是個囤積癖。
很多書。很多貓毛球。很多刺客的照片。*咳咳*

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This house is full of red mushrooms. Are they edible? Why are they only found inside this house? Was the owner farming them?
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
這棟房子里長滿了紅菇。它們能吃嗎？為什麼只有這棟房子裡有？主人是在種植它們嗎？

scripts.text: - MARES is written on the door, along with various drawings that seem to symbolize pirates. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“MARES”，旁邊還有各種象徵海盜的圖案。-

scripts.text: - LMH is written on the door, along with a flurry of hearts drawn on an edge. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“LMH”，邊緣處畫滿了愛心。-

scripts.text: - MISA is written on the door. Various toy weapons are littered around the building. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“MISA”。建築物周圍散落著各種玩具武器。-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
...

[Excavator]
Various pictures are found in this house, all of them featuring the owner with different men.
I find that curious.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
這棟房子裡有很多照片，每一張都是主人和不同的男人在一起。
我覺得這很奇怪。

scripts.text: - ELTOHC is written on the door. In the center of the door is a W drawn in a circle. It could have been the owner's favorite letter. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“ELTOHC”。門的中央畫著一個圓圈，裡面寫著W。這可能是主人最喜歡的字母。-

scripts.text: - LEONA'S BIRD HEAVEN is written on the door. Unsurprisingly, bird feathers are littered around the house. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“LEONA'S BIRD HEAVEN”。不出所料，屋子裡散落著許多羽毛。-

scripts.text: - KURAT is written on the door. The building wall is littered with hand-drawn skulls. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KURAT”。牆壁上畫滿了手繪的骷髏頭。-

scripts.text: - KSY is written on the door. A poster with The Performance of the Century! boldly printed across it is hung on the entrance wall. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KSY”。入口處的牆上掛著一張海報，上面醒目地印著“世紀演出！”。-

scripts.text: - BIBIC & MORZIP'S LOVE HOUSE is written on the door. A couple must have lived in this house. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“BIBIC & MORZIP'S LOVE HOUSE”。一定有一對情侶住在這棟房子裡。-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been a collector of some sort. There are many pictures of women in strange-looking dresses.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
這棟房子的主人一定是某種收藏家。有很多穿著奇怪裙子的女人的照片。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
Did you see the SKM drawn on the door? That reminds me of the other house with hearts drawn on its door.
I hope it's not one of those childish customs. You know, to mark someone as theirs.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
你看到門上畫的SKM了嗎？這讓我想起另一棟門上畫著愛心的房子。
希望那不是那種幼稚的習俗。你知道的，就是標記某人是自己的那種。

scripts.text: - HDY is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“HDY”。-

scripts.text: - BRAN is written on the door. Rows of empty bottles are standing on a side of the house. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“BRAN”。房子的一側整齊地排列著一排排空瓶。-

scripts.text: - KYH is written on the door. This building is in better condition than the rest in the neighborhood.-
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KYH”。這棟建築比周圍其他的房子狀況要好。-

scripts.text: - YAOB is written on the door, along with drawings of round, furry animals. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“YAOB”，旁邊還有圓滾滾、毛茸茸的動物圖案。-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This house is suspected to belong to a couple named SSUL and SINYC.
The house is filled with incredible things. Everything in it is just gorgeous.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
這棟房子據信屬於一對名叫SSUL和SINYC的情侶。
房子裡充滿了不可思議的東西。裡面的每一件東西都非常華麗。

scripts.text: - LMS is written on the door, along with Composition Specialist on an edge. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“LMS”，邊緣處還寫著“作曲專家”。-

scripts.text: - KJK is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KJK”。-

scripts.text: - LJH is written on the door. The building wall is covered with numerous grocery store stickers. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“LJH”。建築牆壁上貼滿了各種雜貨店的貼紙。-

scripts.text: - YG is written on the door. A large picture of a smiling baby is visible through a window. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“YG”。透過窗戶可以看到一張微笑嬰兒的大幅照片。-

scripts.text: - CHJ is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“CHJ”。-

scripts.text:
[Archaeologist]
Sometimes, we gather around to talk.
Sharing information is a part of the job.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
有時候，我們會聚在一起聊天。
分享資訊也是工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
What's the hardest thing about my job?
When I'm forced to eat a terrible lunch provided by my sponsor.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家]
我工作中最難的是什麼？
就是被迫吃贊助方提供的難以下嚥的午餐。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
In fact, it's been that way since I arrived in Verus City.
Today was not an exception.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家]
事實上，自從我來到維魯斯城以來，情況一直如此。
今天也不例外。

scripts.text:
[New Excavator]
I have a lot to learn, and I'm a fast learner.
For now, I'm doing mostly physical tasks.
scripts.translation:
[新來的挖掘者]
我還有很多要學的，而且我學得很快。
目前，我主要做一些體力活。

scripts.text:
[New Excavator]
I'm given free food, a place to sleep, and money. What else can I ask for?
scripts.translation:
[新來的挖掘者]
我有免費的食物、睡覺的地方，還有錢。我還能要求什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Civilization Researcher]
I thought this was a part of Juperos.
I'm now reconsidering that theory.
scripts.translation:
[文明研究員]
我原本以為這是朱佩洛斯的一部分。
現在我正在重新考慮這個理論。

scripts.text:
[Civilization Researcher]
Verus is similar to Juperos, yet different.
Everything about it is more refined and sophisticated somehow.
scripts.translation:
[文明研究員]
維魯斯與朱佩洛斯相似，卻又不同。
這裡的每一樣東西都顯得更加精緻和考究。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
This city's level of mechanical engineering is astonishing.
There's no trace of magic.
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
這座城市的機械工程水平令人驚歎。
這裡沒有任何魔法的痕跡。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
But I'm concerned:
rapid development and sudden introduction of advanced technology could do more harm than good.
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
但我有些擔憂：
快速的發展和先進技術的突然引入，可能會弊大於利。

scripts.text:
^FF0000- Caution -
- For your safety, -
- avoid running -
- or jumping -
- while inside. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^FF0000- 注意 -
- 為了您的安全， -
- 請勿在室內 -
- 奔跑 -
- 或跳躍。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Merchant]
Ho ho ho!
I came first, so I took the best spot!
scripts.translation:
[商人]
呵呵呵！
我來得早，所以佔了最好的位置！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer ?]
*Stomach rumbles*
Aww, I'm hungry...
scripts.translation:
[冒險者？]
*肚子咕咕叫*
哎呀，我餓了...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
But I have no money to buy food...
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
但我沒錢買食物...

scripts.text:
[Jean Baljean]
Ugh, I was struck 19 times for a piece of bread.
scripts.translation:
[讓·巴爾讓]
唉，為了買一塊麵包，我被打了19次。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Mushrooms growing out of rocks.
How resilient!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
從岩石里長出的蘑菇。
生命力真頑強！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Argh!
So many paths are blocked!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
啊！
這麼多路都被堵住了！

scripts.text:
[Cow]
*Moo*
scripts.translation:
[奶牛]
*哞*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Heh. *Drool*
This place is incredible!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
嘿。*流口水*
這地方太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
This site is amazing.
No wonder why Rekenber called dibs on it.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
這地方真不錯。
難怪雷肯貝爾會先佔下這裡。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I want to find something awesome!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
我想找到點厲害的東西！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
The coming era will be yours.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
未來的時代將屬於你。

scripts.text:
[Warning]
Attention visitors of Phantasmagorika,
scripts.translation:
[警告]
致幻魔卡（Phantasmagorika）的訪客們：

scripts.text:
[Warning]
a cult group called the Doom Prayers has been frequently sighted in this area.
scripts.translation:
[警告]
名為“末日祈禱團”的邪教組織頻繁出現在此區域。

scripts.text:
[Warning]
If you're a victim or a witness to the group's harassment, please report to the Phantasmagorika Police.
- Phantasmagorika Police Chief -
scripts.translation:
[警告]
如果您是該組織的受害者或目擊者，請向幻魔卡警方報案。
- 幻魔卡警長 -

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
I must investi... ga... te...
Zzz... Zzz...

[Adventurer Cat]
*Purr*
*Meow*
scripts.translation:
[冒險貓]
*呼嚕*
*喵*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
For some reason, I can't stand up.
*Meow*
scripts.translation:
[冒險貓]
不知道為什麼，我站不起來了。
*喵*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
I've got a good spot.
*Purr*
scripts.translation:
[冒險貓]
我找到了個好地方。
*呼嚕*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Ah!
I want to see!
Why can't I go in?!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
啊！
我想進去看看！
為什麼進不去？！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
All right!
This time, I'm going to write a report on a field trip to Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
好吧！
這次我要寫一篇關於幻魔卡實地考察的報告。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Professor Jones will be so impressed he'll give me A+. *Chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
瓊斯教授一定會很 impressed，給我打A+的。*輕笑*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Toh!
Sound mind, sound body!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
托！
身心強健！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I'd better pack enough potions for the trip to Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
去幻魔卡旅行，我得備足藥水。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I'm impressed by Rekenber's support.
Um...
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
雷肯貝爾的支援讓我很感動。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Merchant]
Ooooh!
I've found a perfect spot for my business!
scripts.translation:
[商人]
哦哦！
我找到了做生意的完美地點！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Elevator? The scientific advancement of Schwarzwald is astonishing!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
電梯？修瓦魯茲巴魯德的科技水平真是令人驚歎！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
An ancient civilization. Doesn't that sound incredible?
I feel like I can hear ancient machines moving with loud clanking noises.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
古代文明。這聽起來不可思議嗎？
我彷彿能聽到古老的機器發出巨大的咔噠聲在運轉。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
*Dreamy eyes*
*Gaping mouth*
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
